home.h1: Packing tables and workbenches made to your size
home.usp1.d: You set the worktop width, depth and height yourself. The width can be 500 to 3000 mm and the depth 400 to 1500 mm.
home.usp2.d: The frame is made of aluminium profiles with an 8 mm slot. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
home.usp3.d: You rotate the table and see every change at once. A combination that cannot be made is refused by the system.
home.usp4.d: The table is made to order. Assembly is optional: with it you get the table assembled, without it disassembled.
home.extras: You can add castors, perforated tool panels, LED lighting, steel drawers, a power strip with sockets and a holder for a PET bottle. Cut-outs can be added to the worktop.
home.cta2.d: Set the dimensions and accessories and send your order. Prices are shown excl. VAT.
faq.1.q: Can I choose my own dimensions?
faq.1.a: Yes. You set the width (500 to 3000 mm), the depth (400 to 1500 mm) and the height of the worktop yourself. Above 1500 mm of width the table gets an additional middle leg at the front and at the back.
faq.2.q: What is the frame made of?
faq.2.a: Aluminium profiles with a 30 × 30 mm cross-section and an 8 mm slot, joined with corner connectors. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
faq.3.a: Castors, perforated tool panels, LED lighting, steel drawers, a power strip with sockets and a holder for a PET bottle. You can also add lower shelves (up to 10, depending on the height of the table) and cut-outs in the worktop. Panels and LED lighting need a table width of at least 1200 mm.
faq.4.q: What if I choose a combination that cannot be made?
faq.4.a: The system refuses it and shows the reason. Every valid configuration is a table that can really be made.
faq.5.q: What is the delivery time and how is the table delivered?
faq.5.a: The table is made to order. Delivery takes 3–5 weeks. With assembly the table is delivered assembled, without it disassembled.
faq.6.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
faq.7.q: Do I need an account to order?
faq.7.a: No. You can send the order as a guest, without an account.
faq.8.q: How do payment and shipping work?
faq.8.a: Payment is in advance by bank transfer based on a proforma invoice. We set the shipping price after the order and confirm it before the proforma invoice is issued. The proforma invoice including shipping is sent by e-mail after the order is confirmed. The table is made after payment.

faq.9.q: Is assembly included in the delivery?
faq.9.a: No, assembly is an optional service. With it the table is delivered assembled, without it disassembled, and you assemble it yourself. The shipping price depends on whether you choose assembly; we set it after the order and confirm it before the proforma invoice is issued.
home.lead.multi3: Packing tables and workbenches with an aluminium profile frame of 30 × 30, 35 × 35 or 40 × 40 mm. Set the width, depth and height, add shelves and accessories and see the result in 3D. Prices are shown excl. VAT.
home.usp2.d.multi3: The frame is made of aluminium profiles in three sizes: 30 × 30 mm with an 8 mm slot, 35 × 35 mm with an 8 mm slot or the more robust 40 × 40 mm with a 10 mm slot. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
faq.2.q.multi3: What is the frame made of and how do the tables differ?
faq.2.a.multi3: Aluminium profiles. One table has 30 × 30 mm profiles with an 8 mm slot, the ergonomic table 35 × 35 mm profiles with an 8 mm slot and the robust table 40 × 40 mm profiles with a 10 mm slot. The ergonomic table has a sleeve made of 40 × 40 mm square tube (2 mm wall) on its legs, which lets you choose the height mechanically. The dimensions and accessories are set in the same way. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
home.lead.multi: Packing tables and workbenches with an aluminium profile frame of 30 × 30 mm or 40 × 40 mm. Set the width, depth and height, add shelves and accessories and see the result in 3D. Prices are shown excl. VAT.
home.usp2.d.multi: The frame is made of aluminium profiles in two sizes: 30 × 30 mm with an 8 mm slot or the more robust 40 × 40 mm with a 10 mm slot. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
faq.2.q.multi: What is the frame made of and how do the two tables differ?
faq.2.a.multi: Aluminium profiles joined with corner connectors. One table has 30 × 30 mm profiles with an 8 mm slot, the robust table 40 × 40 mm profiles with a 10 mm slot. The dimensions and accessories are set in the same way. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
